vb_textbox.text: Hi! This is the advise that I was given, was helpful and I am passing it on - hopefully it provides to be helpful too, best of luck!The gnomes appear in fixed pairs: Orange & Brown; Green & Pink, Red & Yellow; Blue & Purple. Even though the positions might be different, these are always the pairs.Each gnome from the pair takes you to a different forest with either a orange or red basket. The goal is to consistently reach the forest that has the most mushrooms, the number changes but the link between gnome - higher number of mushrooms stays similar.Keep the colours of the gnomes in mind, the specific details (such as hat/position etc) are irrelevant. Maintain focus and you'll get a lot of mushrooms, best of luck!!!
